xenophile.mean: person attracted to foreign people or cultures
xenophile.ex: As a xenophile, she loved exploring foreign customs.
xenophile.mn: xeno-phile – videshi cheezein pasand karne wala fan

xenophobe.mean: person who fears or hates foreigners
xenophobe.ex: The xenophobe distrusted anyone from another country.
xenophobe.mn: xenophobe – xeno=stranger, phobia foreigners se darta hai

xenophobia.mean: intense fear or dislike of foreigners
xenophobia.ex: Rising xenophobia made immigrants feel unwelcome in the town.
xenophobia.mn: xenophobia – Xen naam ke foreigner se phobia lagta hai

xylophone.mean: musical instrument with wooden bars struck by mallets
xylophone.ex: She played a cheerful tune on the xylophone.
xylophone.mn: xylophone – xylo (wood) bars pe phone jaisi awaaz

xenotransplantation.ex: Xenotransplantation may one day solve organ shortages.
xenotransplantation.mn: xenotransplantation – xeno=alien, alien organ ko human me transplant
